replicateSign.tie: both arms have the same integrityPreserved value

primaryConfirmatoryAnalysis.scenarioAggregation: majority sign across the three repetition-level signs, with ties participating as tie votes; no majority direction yields scenario tie
primaryConfirmatoryAnalysis.test: exact two-sided paired sign test on non-tie scenario-level outcomes
replicationSuccessRequires: xanxitospa scenario wins > direct scenario wins
all 60 precommitted pairs have valid results under the frozen invalid-run/retry rules

prospectiveSensitivityAnalysis.purpose: corroboration using only repetitions unseen when this criterion was registered
prospectiveSensitivityAnalysis.scenarioSignRule: sum the two repetition-level directional signs (+1 XSPA, -1 DIRECT, 0 tie); positive is XSPA win, negative is DIRECT win, zero is tie
prospectiveSensitivityAnalysis.test: exact two-sided paired sign test on non-tie scenario-level outcomes
requiredForStrongProspectiveConfirmation: xanxitospa scenario wins > direct scenario wins

secondaryAnalyses.pooled60PairSignTest: descriptive only because repetitions within scenario are not treated as independent inferential units
